card.name: Antidiuretic hormone in opioid-diuretic warning
card.fires_on: The final piece "tic" of "antidiuretic" in the phrase "release of antidiuretic hormone". It appears in the opioid and diuretic interaction text.

modes.label: antidiuretic hormone
modes.description: The ending "tic" of "antidiuretic", right before the word hormone, in the line about opioids reducing diuretic effect.
modes.example: Opioids can reduce the efficacy of diuretics by inducing the release of antidiure<<tic>> hormone.

card.plain: It fires on the end of the word antidiuretic in the sentence saying opioids can blunt diuretics by releasing antidiuretic hormone.
